title: Acute right iliac fossa pain
stem: You are seeing a 16-year-old male in the Emergency Department with 4 hours of abdominal pain that started peri-umbilically and migrated to the right iliac fossa. He feels nauseated and have lost their appetite. Vital signs: HR 88, BP 118/72, RR 16, Temp 36.8°C, SpO2 98% on air.

title: Vomiting and abdominal distension
stem: A 28-year-old female presents with 36 hours of colicky abdominal pain, bilious vomiting and absolute constipation. Past history includes abdominal surgery. Abdomen is distended with tinkling bowel sounds. HR 104, BP 88/54, Temp 37.8°C.

title: Right upper quadrant pain
stem: A 45-year-old male with BMI 34 presents with 12 hours of constant RUQ pain radiating to the scapula after a fatty meal. Murphy's sign is positive. WCC raised, CRP 68. HR 118, Temp 36.8°C.

title: Acute scrotal pain
stem: A 63-year-old female develops sudden severe unilateral scrotal pain with vomiting. The testis is high-riding and tender; cremasteric reflex is absent. HR 88, Temp 37.8°C.

title: Sudden cold painful leg
stem: A 78-year-old male with atrial fibrillation (not anticoagulated) develops sudden pain in one leg. The limb is pale, cold and pulseless with paraesthesia. Symptoms for 24 hours. HR 104, BP 88/54.
key_features: Six Ps of acute limb ischaemia

title: Severe epigastric pain radiating to back
stem: A 22-year-old female presents with severe epigastric pain radiating to the back, vomiting, and tenderness. Lipase is markedly elevated. Possible alcohol / gallstone risk. HR 118, BP 100/64, Temp 37.8°C, SpO2 96%.

title: Left iliac fossa pain and fever
stem: A 41-year-old male presents with 48 hours of LIF pain, fever and change in bowel habit. Localised LIF tenderness without generalised peritonitis. HR 88, Temp 36.8°C, WCC raised, CRP 48.

title: Sudden severe epigastric pain
stem: A 58-year-old female develops sudden severe epigastric pain with board-like rigidity. NSAID use is noted. HR 104, BP 88/54, Temp 37.8°C. Erect CXR is pending.

title: Sudden back and abdominal pain with collapse
stem: A 72-year-old male smoker presents with sudden severe back/abdominal pain and near-syncope. A pulsatile mass is suspected. HR 118, BP 100/64, pale and clammy.

title: Painful irreducible groin lump
stem: A 18-year-old female presents with a painful irreducible groin lump, vomiting and absolute constipation for 36 hours. The lump is tender and erythematous. HR 88, Temp 37.8°C.

title: Painless breast lump in clinic
stem: A 34-year-old male is referred with a 2.5cm hard breast lump noticed 6 weeks ago. There is skin tethering and a palpable axillary node. Vitals normal.

title: Painless jaundice and weight loss
stem: A 52-year-old female presents with painless jaundice, dark urine, pale stools and 10 kg weight loss. A palpable gallbladder is noted. HR 118, Temp 37.8°C.

title: Fresh rectal bleeding and dizziness
stem: A 67-year-old male presents with large-volume fresh PR bleeding and dizziness. Abdomen soft. HR 88, BP 118/72, Hb pending. On antiplatelet therapy.

title: Painful perianal swelling
stem: A 16-year-old female presents with a painful perianal swelling for 6 hours, fever and difficulty sitting. Fluctuant tender lump at the anal verge. HR 104, Temp 37.8°C.

title: Painful swollen leg after fracture
stem: A 28-year-old male has increasing pain after a tibial fracture treated in cast. Pain is out of proportion with severe pain on passive stretch. HR 118, BP 100/64.

title: Thyroid nodule with compressive symptoms
stem: A 45-year-old female presents with a thyroid nodule, recent voice change and difficulty swallowing solids. TSH is normal. USS shows a suspicious nodule.

title: Blunt abdominal trauma after RTA
stem: A 63-year-old male is brought after a road traffic collision with left upper quadrant pain and left shoulder tip pain. HR 104, BP 88/54, SpO2 98%. FAST is pending.

title: Rapidly progressive limb pain and sepsis
stem: A 78-year-old female diabetic presents with rapidly progressive limb pain out of proportion, skin mottling and sepsis. HR 118, BP 100/64, Temp 37.8°C, lactate raised.

title: Loin to groin pain and haematuria
